top_signals.title: Copper Follows Stock Markets Higher as Democrats Sweep Congress
top_signals.summary: Copper climbed as stock markets turned higher and the dollar dropped after US midterm elections that saw the Democrats sweep Congress.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Swiss Pharmaceutical Industry Loses Ground in Global Innovation Race
top_signals.summary: Innovation in Switzerland’s pharmaceutical industry has fallen for the second year in a row, a new study shows, underscoring how it is trailing foreign competitors in digital research and clinical trials.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
